Original explanations/diagrams/worksheets dated 14 October 2026. The Unit 3 editorial coverage map is available; independent review, conventions and learner evidence remain pending. Work with hypothetical addresses only.
Run python unit3-addressing-calculator.py in the extracted folder. To call another example in Python, use runpy.run_path as shown in the chapter. No external packages or network access. LAN range function deliberately supports IPv4 /0–/30 only; /31,/32 and IPv6 allocation are separate subjects. Script does not discover configuration or prove connectivity. Teacher plan/answers are separate, not access-protected.
Sources: RFC 1918 private space; RFC 4632 CIDR; RFC 3021 /31 links; RFC 4291 IPv6 architecture; RFC 5952 representation; RFC 8200 IPv6; RFC 4861 neighbour discovery; RFC 3849 documentation; IANA special IPv4 registry; Python ipaddress docs. Links appear in the chapter. Curriculum: SCSA 2026 Year 12 syllabus, addressing/subnetting. Standards are linked, not copied as textbook extracts.
